sources.note: SoulSilver: Lugia in Whirl Islands with the Silver Wing (Radio Tower) and Tidal Bell (Kimono Girls, after the 8th badge). HeartGold gets the Silver Wing in Pewter City (Kanto).
HeartGold: Ho-Oh at the Bell Tower roof with the Rainbow Wing (Radio Tower) and Clear Bell (Kimono Girls, after the 8th badge). SoulSilver gets the Rainbow Wing in Pewter City (Kanto).
